ko.title: 3.1%와 6,900만 개의 수표: 뜨거웠던 8월 인플레이션이 내년 사회보장 연금 인상에 미치는 의미

segments.src: A warmer-than-expected August inflation report has put a number on millions of kitchen-table budgets: an early projected Social Security cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) of roughly 3.1% for 2027.
segments.tr: 예상보다 높게 나온 8월 인플레이션 보고서로 인해 수백만 가구의 생활비 예산에 구체적인 수치가 제시되었습니다. 바로 2027년 사회보장 생활비 조정률(COLA)이 약 3.1%로 조기 전망된 것입니다.

segments.src: If that estimate holds once the government finalizes the calculation this fall, it would mark one of the larger annual raises retirees have seen in several years — and a reminder of how closely the nation's largest income-support program is tied to the price of everyday goods.
segments.tr: 올가을 정부가 최종 계산을 마친 후에도 이 추정치가 유지된다면, 이는 은퇴자들이 수년 만에 경험하는 가장 큰 연례 인상 폭 중 하나가 될 것이며, 미국의 가장 큰 소득 지원 프로그램이 일상 소비재 가격과 얼마나 밀접하게 연계되어 있는지 다시 한번 상기시켜 주는 계기가 될 것입니다.

segments.src: ## How the Raise Gets Calculated
segments.tr: ## 인상률 산정 방식

segments.src: Social Security's annual adjustment isn't set by lawmakers or the agency itself.
segments.tr: 사회보장 연금의 연례 조정률은 국회의원이나 사회보장국 자체에서 임의로 결정하지 않습니다.

segments.src: It's derived from a formula written into law that compares average prices in the third quarter (July, August, and September) of the current year to the same period a year earlier, using a specific inflation gauge known as the CPI-W, which tracks spending by urban wage earners and clerical workers.
segments.tr: 이는 법으로 규정된 공식에 따라 산출되는데, 도시 임금 근로자 및 사무직 근로자의 지출을 추적하는 특정 인플레이션 지표인 CPI-W를 사용하여 올해 3분기(7월, 8월, 9월)의 평균 가격을 전년 동기와 비교하는 방식입니다.

segments.src: Because the formula only uses three months of data, a single hot or cool reading can move the final number meaningfully.
segments.tr: 이 공식은 단 3개월 동안의 데이터만 사용하기 때문에, 단 한 번의 높거나 낮은 수치 발표가 최종 결과에 상당한 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: August's report came in above what many economists had penciled in, driven in part by shelter costs, food prices, and energy — categories that weigh heavily on fixed-income households.
segments.tr: 8월 보고서는 많은 경제학자들의 예상치를 웃돌았는데, 이는 고정 소득 가구에 큰 부담이 되는 주거비, 식료품 가격, 에너지 부문이 주도했습니다.

segments.src: With September's data still to come, the projected 3.1% figure is an estimate, not a final number.
segments.tr: 아직 9월 데이터가 남아 있으므로, 전망치인 3.1%는 확정된 수치가 아닌 추정치입니다.

segments.src: The Social Security Administration typically announces the official COLA in mid-October, once the third-quarter data set is complete.
segments.tr: 사회보장국은 보통 3분기 데이터 세트가 완성되는 10월 중순에 공식 COLA를 발표합니다.

segments.src: ## What a 3.1% Raise Would Mean in Dollars
segments.tr: ## 3.1% 인상이 금액 측면에서 의미하는 바

segments.src: For context, recent COLAs have ranged widely — from historic highs during the inflation surge of the early 2020s to leaner increases in calmer years.
segments.tr: 참고로 최근의 COLA는 2020년대 초반 인플레이션 급등기 동안의 역사적인 고점부터 물가가 안정되었던 시기의 미미한 인상까지 그 편차가 컸습니다.

segments.src: A 3.1% bump applied to an average retirement benefit would translate into an increase of roughly $55 to $60 per month for a typical retired worker, though the exact figure varies by individual benefit amount.
segments.tr: 평균 은퇴 연금에 3.1% 인상률을 적용하면 일반적인 은퇴 근로자의 경우 매월 약 $55에서 $60 정도의 인상으로 이어지지만, 정확한 금액은 개인별 수령액에 따라 다릅니다.

segments.src: Multiplied across the more than 69 million Americans who receive Social Security or Supplemental Security Income benefits, the aggregate impact on federal outlays is substantial, which is one reason the annual COLA announcement draws close attention from budget analysts as well as beneficiaries.
segments.tr: 사회보장 연금이나 생활보조금(SSI) 혜택을 받는 6,900만 명 이상의 미국인 전체로 확대해 보면 연방 재정 지출에 미치는 총체적 영향은 상당하며, 이것이 바로 연례 COLA 발표가 수혜자뿐만 아니라 예산 분석가들의 큰 관심을 끄는 이유 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: ## Advocates Say the Formula Still Falls Short
segments.tr: ## 옹호 단체들은 여전히 공식이 미흡하다고 주장

segments.src: Even with a larger-than-average adjustment on the horizon, groups that track senior finances caution that the COLA formula may not fully reflect how older Americans actually spend money.
segments.tr: 평균보다 높은 수준의 조정이 예상됨에도 불구하고, 고령층의 재정을 추적하는 단체들은 COLA 공식이 고령층 미국인들이 실제로 돈을 쓰는 방식을 온전히 반영하지 못할 수 있다고 경고합니다.

segments.src: The CPI-W is built around a working-age household's spending patterns, not a retiree's.
segments.tr: CPI-W는 은퇴자가 아닌 근로 연령대 가구의 지출 패턴을 기준으로 설계되었기 때문입니다.

segments.src: Critics have long argued this understates the true cost pressure seniors face, since retirees typically devote a larger share of their budgets to housing and medical care — two categories that have outpaced general inflation in many recent years.
segments.tr: 비판론자들은 은퇴자들이 일반적으로 예산의 더 큰 부분을 주거비와 의료비에 할애한다는 점을 감안할 때, 이 공식이 고령층이 직면한 실제 물가 압력을 과소평가한다고 오랫동안 주장해 왔습니다. 주거비와 의료비는 최근 수년간 전반적인 인플레이션 속도를 앞지른 두 가지 카테고리입니다.

segments.src: Some advocacy organizations have pushed for Social Security to instead use the CPI-E, an experimental index that more heavily weights spending by Americans age 62 and older, including healthcare and housing costs.
segments.tr: 일부 옹호 단체들은 사회보장 연금에 CPI-W 대신 의료비와 주거비를 포함하여 62세 이상 미국인들의 지출에 더 큰 가중치를 두는 실험적 지수인 CPI-E를 사용할 것을 촉구해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Proponents argue this would produce more accurate — and often larger — annual adjustments.
segments.tr: 지지자들은 이를 통해 더 정확하고, 종종 더 높은 수준의 연례 조정이 이루어질 것이라고 주장합니다.

segments.src: So far, Congress has not adopted the change.
segments.tr: 지금까지 의회는 이 변경안을 채택하지 않았습니다.

segments.src: There's also a timing mismatch worth noting: the COLA is meant to help benefits keep pace with the cost of living, but it's calculated in the fall for the year ahead.
segments.tr: 또한 주목할 만한 시점의 불일치도 있습니다. COLA는 연금 수령액이 생활비 상승 속도를 맞출 수 있도록 돕기 위한 것이지만, 가을에 이듬해의 조정률을 미리 계산합니다.

segments.src: If inflation cools between now and January, retirees could end up ahead of rising costs.
segments.tr: 지금부터 내년 1월 사이에 인플레이션이 둔화된다면 은퇴자들은 물가 상승보다 더 유리한 고지에 서게 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: If it accelerates instead, as it has in recent years, the raise can lag behind actual expenses almost as soon as it takes effect.
segments.tr: 반대로 최근 몇 년처럼 인플레이션이 가속화된다면, 인상안이 시행되자마자 실제 지출 비용보다 뒤처지게 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Medicare Premiums Could Offset Part of the Gain
segments.tr: ## 메디케어 보험료가 인상분의 일부를 상쇄할 수도 있음

segments.src: For many retirees, the real-world impact of a COLA increase depends heavily on what happens to Medicare Part B premiums, which are usually deducted directly from Social Security checks.
segments.tr: 많은 은퇴자들에게 COLA 인상의 실질적인 효과는 보통 사회보장 연금 수표에서 직접 공제되는 메디케어 파트 B(Medicare Part B) 보험료의 변동 여부에 크게 좌우됩니다.

segments.src: Part B premiums have risen in most recent years, sometimes eating into a meaningful share of the annual raise before it ever reaches a beneficiary's bank account.
segments.tr: 파트 B 보험료는 최근 몇 년 동안 대부분 상승했으며, 때로는 연례 인상분이 수혜자의 은행 계좌에 입금되기도 전에 상당 부분을 잠식하기도 했습니다.

segments.src: Medicare's premium figures for next year are typically announced around the same time as the COLA, and the two numbers are usually read together by financial planners who work with retirees.
segments.tr: 내년도 메디케어 보험료 수치는 보통 COLA와 비슷한 시기에 발표되며, 은퇴자들과 일하는 재무 설계사들은 대개 이 두 수치를 함께 분석합니다.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 향후 일정

segments.src: The Bureau of Labor Statistics will release September's inflation data in the coming weeks, which will finalize the COLA calculation.
segments.tr: 연방 노동통계국은 향후 몇 주 안에 9월 인플레이션 데이터를 발표할 예정이며, 이를 통해 COLA 계산이 최종 확정됩니다.

segments.src: The Social Security Administration will then issue its official announcement, most likely in mid-October, setting the exact percentage that will apply to benefits starting in January.
segments.tr: 이후 사회보장국은 이르면 10월 중순에 공식 발표를 통해 내년 1월부터 지급되는 연금에 적용될 정확한 인상률을 확정할 예정입니다.

segments.src: Until then, the 3.1% figure should be treated as an informed estimate based on partial data rather than a confirmed number.
segments.tr: 그때까지는 3.1%라는 수치를 확정된 값이 아니라 일부 데이터에 기반한 정보에 입각한 추정치로 취급해야 합니다.

segments.src: Beneficiaries who want to plan ahead can watch for the official announcement and use the Social Security Administration's own benefit statements and online tools to see how any adjustment will apply to their specific monthly payment.
segments.tr: 미리 계획을 세우고자 하는 수혜자들은 공식 발표를 주시하고, 사회보장국의 자체 연금 명세서 및 온라인 도구를 활용하여 이러한 조정이 자신의 구체적인 월 수령액에 어떻게 적용되는지 확인할 수 있습니다.

segments.tr: *본 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공 목적으로 작성되었으며 재정적, 법적 또는 세무적 조언을 구성하지 않습니다.

segments.src: Readers should consult the Social Security Administration or a qualified financial professional regarding their individual benefits.*
segments.tr: 독자는 개인의 혜택과 관련하여 사회보장국이나 자격을 갖춘 재무 전문가와 상담해야 합니다.*

zh.title: 3.1% 和 6900 万张支票：8 月份的高通胀对明年社会保障金的增长意味着什么

segments.src: A warmer-than-expected August inflation report has put a number on millions of kitchen-table budgets: an early projected Social Security cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) of roughly 3.1% for 2027.
segments.tr: 一份高于预期的 8 月份通胀报告为数百万家庭的预算设定了一个数字：预计 2027 年社会保障生活成本调整 (COLA) 初步约为 3.1%。

segments.src: If that estimate holds once the government finalizes the calculation this fall, it would mark one of the larger annual raises retirees have seen in several years — and a reminder of how closely the nation's largest income-support program is tied to the price of everyday goods.
segments.tr: 如果这一估算在政府今年秋季最终确定计算结果后保持不变，这将标志着退休人员近年来看到的较大年度涨幅之一——同时也提醒人们，美国最大的收入支持计划与日常商品价格之间的联系有多么紧密。

segments.src: ## How the Raise Gets Calculated
segments.tr: ## 涨幅是如何计算的

segments.src: Social Security's annual adjustment isn't set by lawmakers or the agency itself.
segments.tr: 社会保障的年度调整并非由立法者或该机构本身设定。

segments.src: It's derived from a formula written into law that compares average prices in the third quarter (July, August, and September) of the current year to the same period a year earlier, using a specific inflation gauge known as the CPI-W, which tracks spending by urban wage earners and clerical workers.
segments.tr: 它是根据法律规定的公式得出的，该公式将当前年份第三季度（7 月、8 月和 9 月）的平均价格与一年前同期进行比较，使用的是一种称为 CPI-W 的特定通胀指标，该指标追踪城市工薪阶层和文职人员的支出。

segments.src: Because the formula only uses three months of data, a single hot or cool reading can move the final number meaningfully.
segments.tr: 由于该公式仅使用三个月的数据，因此任何一次高或低的读数都可能对最终数字产生重大影响。

segments.src: August's report came in above what many economists had penciled in, driven in part by shelter costs, food prices, and energy — categories that weigh heavily on fixed-income households.
segments.tr: 8 月份的报告结果高于许多经济学家的预期，部分原因是住房成本、食品价格和能源——这些类别对固定收入家庭的影响很大。

segments.src: With September's data still to come, the projected 3.1% figure is an estimate, not a final number.
segments.tr: 由于 9 月份的数据尚未公布，预计 3.1% 的数字只是一个估算值，而非最终数字。

segments.src: The Social Security Administration typically announces the official COLA in mid-October, once the third-quarter data set is complete.
segments.tr: 社会保障局通常会在第三季度数据集完成后，于 10 月中旬宣布正式的 COLA。

segments.src: ## What a 3.1% Raise Would Mean in Dollars
segments.tr: ## 3.1% 的涨幅意味着多少美元

segments.src: For context, recent COLAs have ranged widely — from historic highs during the inflation surge of the early 2020s to leaner increases in calmer years.
segments.tr: 作为背景，近期的 COLA 波动很大——从 2020 年代初通胀飙升期间的历史高点到平静年份的微小增长。

segments.src: A 3.1% bump applied to an average retirement benefit would translate into an increase of roughly $55 to $60 per month for a typical retired worker, though the exact figure varies by individual benefit amount.
segments.tr: 将 3.1% 的涨幅应用于平均退休福利，对于典型的退休工人来说，每月大约增加 55 至 60 美元，尽管具体数字因个人福利金额而异。

segments.src: Multiplied across the more than 69 million Americans who receive Social Security or Supplemental Security Income benefits, the aggregate impact on federal outlays is substantial, which is one reason the annual COLA announcement draws close attention from budget analysts as well as beneficiaries.
segments.tr: 乘以超过 6900 万领取社会保障或补充保障收入福利的美国人，对联邦支出的总体影响是巨大的，这也是年度 COLA 公告受到预算分析师和受益人密切关注的原因之一。

segments.src: ## Advocates Say the Formula Still Falls Short
segments.tr: ## 倡导者认为该公式仍有不足

segments.src: Even with a larger-than-average adjustment on the horizon, groups that track senior finances caution that the COLA formula may not fully reflect how older Americans actually spend money.
segments.tr: 即使即将迎来高于平均水平的调整，追踪老年人财务状况的团体仍警告称，COLA 公式可能无法完全反映美国老年人的实际消费方式。

segments.src: The CPI-W is built around a working-age household's spending patterns, not a retiree's.
segments.tr: CPI-W 是围绕劳动年龄家庭的消费模式构建的，而不是退休人员的消费模式。

segments.src: Critics have long argued this understates the true cost pressure seniors face, since retirees typically devote a larger share of their budgets to housing and medical care — two categories that have outpaced general inflation in many recent years.
segments.tr: 批评人士长期以来一直认为，这低估了老年人面临的真实成本压力，因为退休人员通常将预算中更大比例的资金用于住房和医疗保健——这两个类别在近年来许多时候的涨幅都超过了总体通胀率。

segments.src: Some advocacy organizations have pushed for Social Security to instead use the CPI-E, an experimental index that more heavily weights spending by Americans age 62 and older, including healthcare and housing costs.
segments.tr: 一些倡导组织推动社会保障部门改用 CPI-E，这是一种实验性指数，它更侧重于 62 岁及以上美国人的支出，包括医疗保健和住房成本。

segments.src: Proponents argue this would produce more accurate — and often larger — annual adjustments.
segments.tr: 支持者认为，这将产生更准确——且通常更高——的年度调整。

segments.src: So far, Congress has not adopted the change.
segments.tr: 到目前为止，国会尚未采纳这一改变。

segments.src: There's also a timing mismatch worth noting: the COLA is meant to help benefits keep pace with the cost of living, but it's calculated in the fall for the year ahead.
segments.tr: 还有一个值得注意的时间错配问题：COLA 旨在帮助福利跟上生活成本的步伐，但它是在秋季为来年计算的。

segments.src: If inflation cools between now and January, retirees could end up ahead of rising costs.
segments.tr: 如果从现在到 1 月份通胀降温，退休人员最终可能会领先于不断上涨的成本。

segments.src: If it accelerates instead, as it has in recent years, the raise can lag behind actual expenses almost as soon as it takes effect.
segments.tr: 如果通胀反而加速，正如近年来所发生的那样，那么涨幅在生效后几乎立即就会落后于实际支出。

segments.src: ## Medicare Premiums Could Offset Part of the Gain
segments.tr: ## 医疗保险保费可能会抵消部分收益

segments.src: For many retirees, the real-world impact of a COLA increase depends heavily on what happens to Medicare Part B premiums, which are usually deducted directly from Social Security checks.
segments.tr: 对于许多退休人员来说，COLA 增加的实际影响在很大程度上取决于医疗保险 B 部分 (Medicare Part B) 保费的变化，这些保费通常直接从社会保障支票中扣除。

segments.src: Part B premiums have risen in most recent years, sometimes eating into a meaningful share of the annual raise before it ever reaches a beneficiary's bank account.
segments.tr: 近年来，B 部分保费大部分时间都在上涨，有时在年度涨幅到达受益人银行账户之前，就已经消耗掉了其中很大一部分。

segments.src: Medicare's premium figures for next year are typically announced around the same time as the COLA, and the two numbers are usually read together by financial planners who work with retirees.
segments.tr: 医疗保险明年的保费数字通常在宣布 COLA 的同时公布，与退休人员合作的财务规划师通常会将这两个数字结合起来解读。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: The Bureau of Labor Statistics will release September's inflation data in the coming weeks, which will finalize the COLA calculation.
segments.tr: 劳工统计局将在未来几周内发布 9 月份的通胀数据，这将最终确定 COLA 的计算结果。

segments.src: The Social Security Administration will then issue its official announcement, most likely in mid-October, setting the exact percentage that will apply to benefits starting in January.
segments.tr: 社会保障局随后将发布正式公告，很可能在 10 月中旬，确定从 1 月份开始适用于福利的确切百分比。

segments.src: Until then, the 3.1% figure should be treated as an informed estimate based on partial data rather than a confirmed number.
segments.tr: 在此之前，3.1% 的数字应被视为基于部分数据的知情估算，而非确认数字。

segments.src: Beneficiaries who want to plan ahead can watch for the official announcement and use the Social Security Administration's own benefit statements and online tools to see how any adjustment will apply to their specific monthly payment.
segments.tr: 想要提前规划的受益人可以留意正式公告，并使用社会保障局自己的福利声明和在线工具，查看任何调整将如何应用于他们特定的每月付款。

hi.title: 3.1% और 69 मिलियन चेक: अगस्त की गर्म मुद्रास्फीति का अगले वर्ष की सामाजिक सुरक्षा वृद्धि के लिए क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: A warmer-than-expected August inflation report has put a number on millions of kitchen-table budgets: an early projected Social Security cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) of roughly 3.1% for 2027.
segments.tr: उम्मीद से अधिक गर्म अगस्त मुद्रास्फीति रिपोर्ट ने लाखों घरेलू बजटों पर एक आंकड़ा तय कर दिया है: 2027 के लिए लगभग 3.1% का शुरुआती अनुमानित सामाजिक सुरक्षा जीवन-यापन समायोजन (COLA)।

segments.src: If that estimate holds once the government finalizes the calculation this fall, it would mark one of the larger annual raises retirees have seen in several years — and a reminder of how closely the nation's largest income-support program is tied to the price of everyday goods.
segments.tr: यदि इस शरद ऋतु में सरकार द्वारा गणना को अंतिम रूप दिए जाने के बाद वह अनुमान बना रहता है, तो यह सेवानिवृत्त लोगों द्वारा कई वर्षों में देखी गई सबसे बड़ी वार्षिक वृद्धि में से एक होगी — और यह इस बात की याद दिलाती है कि देश का सबसे बड़ा आय-सहायता कार्यक्रम रोजमर्रा की वस्तुओं की कीमत से कितना करीब से जुड़ा हुआ है।

segments.src: ## How the Raise Gets Calculated
segments.tr: ## वृद्धि की गणना कैसे की जाती है

segments.src: Social Security's annual adjustment isn't set by lawmakers or the agency itself.
segments.tr: सामाजिक सुरक्षा का वार्षिक समायोजन सांसदों या स्वयं एजेंसी द्वारा तय नहीं किया जाता है।

segments.src: It's derived from a formula written into law that compares average prices in the third quarter (July, August, and September) of the current year to the same period a year earlier, using a specific inflation gauge known as the CPI-W, which tracks spending by urban wage earners and clerical workers.
segments.tr: यह कानून में लिखे गए एक सूत्र से प्राप्त होता है जो चालू वर्ष की तीसरी तिमाही (जुलाई, अगस्त और सितंबर) में औसत कीमतों की तुलना एक साल पहले की इसी अवधि से करता है, जिसमें CPI-W के रूप में जानी जाने वाली एक विशिष्ट मुद्रास्फीति माप का उपयोग किया जाता है, जो शहरी वेतन भोगियों और लिपिक कर्मचारियों द्वारा किए जाने वाले खर्च पर नज़र रखती है।

segments.src: Because the formula only uses three months of data, a single hot or cool reading can move the final number meaningfully.
segments.tr: चूंकि यह सूत्र केवल तीन महीनों के डेटा का उपयोग करता है, इसलिए एक भी गर्म या ठंडी रीडिंग अंतिम संख्या को महत्वपूर्ण रूप से बदल सकती है।

segments.src: August's report came in above what many economists had penciled in, driven in part by shelter costs, food prices, and energy — categories that weigh heavily on fixed-income households.
segments.tr: अगस्त की रिपोर्ट कई अर्थशास्त्रियों के अनुमान से अधिक रही, जो आंशिक रूप से आवास लागत, खाद्य कीमतों और ऊर्जा द्वारा संचालित थी — ऐसी श्रेणियां जो निश्चित आय वाले परिवारों पर भारी पड़ती हैं।

segments.src: With September's data still to come, the projected 3.1% figure is an estimate, not a final number.
segments.tr: सितंबर के आंकड़े अभी आने बाकी हैं, इसलिए अनुमानित 3.1% का आंकड़ा एक अनुमान है, अंतिम संख्या नहीं।

segments.src: The Social Security Administration typically announces the official COLA in mid-October, once the third-quarter data set is complete.
segments.tr: सोशल सिक्योरिटी एडमिनिस्ट्रेशन आमतौर पर अक्टूबर के मध्य में आधिकारिक COLA की घोषणा करता है, एक बार जब तीसरी तिमाही का डेटा सेट पूरा हो जाता है।

segments.src: ## What a 3.1% Raise Would Mean in Dollars
segments.tr: ## 3.1% की वृद्धि का डॉलर में क्या अर्थ होगा

segments.src: For context, recent COLAs have ranged widely — from historic highs during the inflation surge of the early 2020s to leaner increases in calmer years.
segments.tr: संदर्भ के लिए, हाल के COLA व्यापक रूप से भिन्न रहे हैं — 2020 के दशक की शुरुआत में मुद्रास्फीति में वृद्धि के दौरान ऐतिहासिक उच्च स्तर से लेकर अधिक शांत वर्षों में धीमी वृद्धि तक।

segments.src: A 3.1% bump applied to an average retirement benefit would translate into an increase of roughly $55 to $60 per month for a typical retired worker, though the exact figure varies by individual benefit amount.
segments.tr: एक औसत सेवानिवृत्ति लाभ पर लागू 3.1% की वृद्धि का अर्थ एक ठेठ सेवानिवृत्त कार्यकर्ता के लिए लगभग $55 से $60 प्रति माह की वृद्धि होगी, हालांकि सटीक आंकड़ा व्यक्तिगत लाभ राशि के अनुसार भिन्न होता है।

segments.src: Multiplied across the more than 69 million Americans who receive Social Security or Supplemental Security Income benefits, the aggregate impact on federal outlays is substantial, which is one reason the annual COLA announcement draws close attention from budget analysts as well as beneficiaries.
segments.tr: सामाजिक सुरक्षा या पूरक सुरक्षा आय लाभ प्राप्त करने वाले 69 मिलियन से अधिक अमेरिकियों में गुणा करने पर, संघीय परिव्यय पर कुल प्रभाव महत्वपूर्ण होता है, जो एक कारण है कि वार्षिक COLA घोषणा बजट विश्लेषकों के साथ-साथ लाभार्थियों का भी ध्यान आकर्षित करती है।

segments.src: ## Advocates Say the Formula Still Falls Short
segments.tr: ## पैरोकारों का कहना है कि सूत्र अभी भी कम पड़ता है

segments.src: Even with a larger-than-average adjustment on the horizon, groups that track senior finances caution that the COLA formula may not fully reflect how older Americans actually spend money.
segments.tr: औसत से अधिक समायोजन की संभावना के बावजूद, वरिष्ठ नागरिकों के वित्त पर नज़र रखने वाले समूह चेतावनी देते हैं कि COLA सूत्र पूरी तरह से यह प्रतिबिंबित नहीं कर सकता है कि वृद्ध अमेरिकी वास्तव में पैसा कैसे खर्च करते हैं।

segments.src: The CPI-W is built around a working-age household's spending patterns, not a retiree's.
segments.tr: CPI-W एक कामकाजी उम्र के परिवार के खर्च के पैटर्न पर आधारित है, न कि एक सेवानिवृत्त व्यक्ति के।

segments.src: Critics have long argued this understates the true cost pressure seniors face, since retirees typically devote a larger share of their budgets to housing and medical care — two categories that have outpaced general inflation in many recent years.
segments.tr: आलोचकों ने लंबे समय से तर्क दिया है कि यह वरिष्ठ नागरिकों का सामना करने वाले वास्तविक लागत दबाव को कम आंकता है, क्योंकि सेवानिवृत्त लोग आमतौर पर अपने बजट का एक बड़ा हिस्सा आवास और चिकित्सा देखभाल पर खर्च करते हैं — दो ऐसी श्रेणियां जो हाल के कई वर्षों में सामान्य मुद्रास्फीति से आगे निकल गई हैं।

segments.src: Some advocacy organizations have pushed for Social Security to instead use the CPI-E, an experimental index that more heavily weights spending by Americans age 62 and older, including healthcare and housing costs.
segments.tr: कुछ वकालत संगठनों ने सामाजिक सुरक्षा से इसके बजाय CPI-E का उपयोग करने का दबाव डाला है, जो एक प्रयोगात्मक सूचकांक है जो स्वास्थ्य सेवा और आवास लागतों सहित 62 वर्ष और उससे अधिक आयु के अमेरिकियों द्वारा किए जाने वाले खर्च को अधिक महत्व देता है।

segments.src: Proponents argue this would produce more accurate — and often larger — annual adjustments.
segments.tr: समर्थकों का तर्क है कि इससे अधिक सटीक — और अक्सर बड़े — वार्षिक समायोजन प्राप्त होंगे।

segments.src: So far, Congress has not adopted the change.
segments.tr: अभी तक, कांग्रेस ने इस बदलाव को नहीं अपनाया है।

segments.src: There's also a timing mismatch worth noting: the COLA is meant to help benefits keep pace with the cost of living, but it's calculated in the fall for the year ahead.
segments.tr: ध्यान देने योग्य एक समय का बेमेल भी है: COLA का उद्देश्य लाभों को जीवन-यापन की लागत के साथ तालमेल बनाए रखने में मदद करना है, लेकिन इसकी गणना आने वाले वर्ष के लिए शरद ऋतु में की जाती है।

segments.src: If inflation cools between now and January, retirees could end up ahead of rising costs.
segments.tr: यदि अब और जनवरी के बीच मुद्रास्फीति ठंडी होती है, तो सेवानिवृत्त लोग बढ़ती लागतों से आगे निकल सकते हैं।

segments.src: If it accelerates instead, as it has in recent years, the raise can lag behind actual expenses almost as soon as it takes effect.
segments.tr: इसके विपरीत यदि यह तेज होती है, जैसा कि हाल के वर्षों में हुआ है, तो वृद्धि लागू होते ही वास्तविक खर्चों से पीछे छूट सकती है।

segments.src: ## Medicare Premiums Could Offset Part of the Gain
segments.tr: ## मेडिकेयर प्रीमियम लाभ का हिस्सा निष्प्रभावी कर सकते हैं

segments.src: For many retirees, the real-world impact of a COLA increase depends heavily on what happens to Medicare Part B premiums, which are usually deducted directly from Social Security checks.
segments.tr: कई सेवानिवृत्त लोगों के लिए, COLA वृद्धि का वास्तविक प्रभाव काफी हद तक इस बात पर निर्भर करता है कि मेडिकेयर पार्ट B प्रीमियम का क्या होता है, जो आमतौर पर सीधे सामाजिक सुरक्षा चेक से काटा जाता है।

segments.src: Part B premiums have risen in most recent years, sometimes eating into a meaningful share of the annual raise before it ever reaches a beneficiary's bank account.
segments.tr: पार्ट B प्रीमियम हाल के अधिकांश वर्षों में बढ़े हैं, जिससे लाभार्थी के बैंक खाते में पहुँचने से पहले ही वार्षिक वृद्धि का एक बड़ा हिस्सा समाप्त हो जाता है।

segments.src: Medicare's premium figures for next year are typically announced around the same time as the COLA, and the two numbers are usually read together by financial planners who work with retirees.
segments.tr: अगले वर्ष के लिए मेडिकेयर के प्रीमियम आंकड़े आमतौर पर COLA के आसपास ही घोषित किए जाते हैं, और सेवानिवृत्त लोगों के साथ काम करने वाले वित्तीय योजनाकारों द्वारा दोनों आंकड़ों को आमतौर पर एक साथ पढ़ा जाता है।

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होगा

segments.src: The Bureau of Labor Statistics will release September's inflation data in the coming weeks, which will finalize the COLA calculation.
segments.tr: ब्यूरो ऑफ लेबर स्टैटिस्टिक्स आने वाले हफ्तों में सितंबर के मुद्रास्फीति आंकड़े जारी करेगा, जो COLA की गणना को अंतिम रूप देगा।

segments.src: The Social Security Administration will then issue its official announcement, most likely in mid-October, setting the exact percentage that will apply to benefits starting in January.
segments.tr: इसके बाद सोशल सिक्योरिटी एडमिनिस्ट्रेशन अपनी आधिकारिक घोषणा जारी करेगा, संभवतः मध्य-अक्टूबर में, सटीक प्रतिशत निर्धारित करेगा जो जनवरी से शुरू होने वाले लाभों पर लागू होगा।

segments.src: Until then, the 3.1% figure should be treated as an informed estimate based on partial data rather than a confirmed number.
segments.tr: तब तक, 3.1% के आंकड़े को एक पुष्टि की गई संख्या के बजाय आंशिक डेटा के आधार पर एक सूचित अनुमान के रूप में माना जाना चाहिए।

segments.src: Beneficiaries who want to plan ahead can watch for the official announcement and use the Social Security Administration's own benefit statements and online tools to see how any adjustment will apply to their specific monthly payment.
segments.tr: जो लाभार्थी आगे की योजना बनाना चाहते हैं, वे आधिकारिक घोषणा का इंतजार कर सकते हैं और सोशल सिक्योरिटी एडमिनिस्ट्रेशन के अपने लाभ बयानों और ऑनलाइन उपकरणों का उपयोग करके देख सकते हैं कि कोई भी समायोजन उनके विशिष्ट मासिक भुगतान पर कैसे लागू होगा।

segments.src: Readers should consult the Social Security Administration or a qualified financial professional regarding their individual benefits.*
segments.tr: पाठकों को अपने व्यक्तिगत लाभों के संबंध में सोशल सिक्योरिटी एडमिनिस्ट्रेशन या किसी योग्य वित्तीय पेशेवर से परामर्श करना चाहिए।*

segments.tr: El informe de agosto resultó por encima de lo que muchos economistas habían previsto, impulsado en parte por los costos de vivienda, los precios de los alimentos y la energía, categorías que pesan mucho en los hogares de ingresos fijos.

segments.src: With September's data still to come, the projected 3.1% figure is an estimate, not a final number.
segments.tr: Con los datos de septiembre aún por llegar, la cifra proyectada del 3.1% es una estimación, no un número final.

segments.src: The Social Security Administration typically announces the official COLA in mid-October, once the third-quarter data set is complete.
segments.tr: La Administración del Seguro Social generalmente anuncia el COLA oficial a mediados de octubre, una vez que el conjunto de datos del tercer trimestre esté completo.

segments.src: ## What a 3.1% Raise Would Mean in Dollars
segments.tr: ## Qué significaría un aumento del 3.1% en dólares

segments.src: For context, recent COLAs have ranged widely — from historic highs during the inflation surge of the early 2020s to leaner increases in calmer years.
segments.tr: Para ponerlo en contexto, los COLA recientes han variado ampliamente, desde máximos históricos durante el aumento de la inflación de principios de la década de 2020 hasta aumentos más modestos en años más tranquilos.

segments.src: A 3.1% bump applied to an average retirement benefit would translate into an increase of roughly $55 to $60 per month for a typical retired worker, though the exact figure varies by individual benefit amount.
segments.tr: Un aumento del 3.1% aplicado a un beneficio de jubilación promedio se traduciría en un incremento de aproximadamente $55 a $60 por mes para un trabajador jubilado típico, aunque la cifra exacta varía según el monto del beneficio individual.

segments.src: Multiplied across the more than 69 million Americans who receive Social Security or Supplemental Security Income benefits, the aggregate impact on federal outlays is substantial, which is one reason the annual COLA announcement draws close attention from budget analysts as well as beneficiaries.
segments.tr: Multiplicado por los más de 69 millones de estadounidenses que reciben beneficios del Seguro Social o de Seguridad de Ingreso Suplementario, el impacto agregado en los gastos federales es sustancial, lo cual es una razón por la que el anuncio anual del COLA atrae mucha atención tanto de los analistas presupuestarios como de los beneficiarios.

segments.src: ## Advocates Say the Formula Still Falls Short
segments.tr: ## Los defensores dicen que la fórmula sigue siendo insuficiente

segments.src: Even with a larger-than-average adjustment on the horizon, groups that track senior finances caution that the COLA formula may not fully reflect how older Americans actually spend money.
segments.tr: Incluso con un ajuste mayor al promedio en el horizonte, los grupos que rastrean las finanzas de las personas mayores advierten que la fórmula del COLA puede no reflejar completamente cómo gastan realmente el dinero los estadounidenses mayores.

segments.src: The CPI-W is built around a working-age household's spending patterns, not a retiree's.
segments.tr: El CPI-W está construido en torno a los patrones de gasto de un hogar en edad laboral, no de un jubilado.

segments.src: Critics have long argued this understates the true cost pressure seniors face, since retirees typically devote a larger share of their budgets to housing and medical care — two categories that have outpaced general inflation in many recent years.
segments.tr: Los críticos han argumentado durante mucho tiempo que esto subestima la verdadera presión de costos que enfrentan las personas mayores, ya que los jubilados suelen dedicar una mayor parte de sus presupuestos a la vivienda y la atención médica, dos categorías que han superado la inflación general en muchos años recientes.

segments.src: Some advocacy organizations have pushed for Social Security to instead use the CPI-E, an experimental index that more heavily weights spending by Americans age 62 and older, including healthcare and housing costs.
segments.tr: Algunas organizaciones de defensa han presionado para que el Seguro Social utilice en su lugar el CPI-E, un índice experimental que pondera más fuertemente el gasto de los estadounidenses de 62 años o más, incluidos los costos de atención médica y vivienda.

segments.src: Proponents argue this would produce more accurate — and often larger — annual adjustments.
segments.tr: Los defensores argumentan que esto produciría ajustes anuales más precisos, y a menudo mayores.

segments.src: So far, Congress has not adopted the change.
segments.tr: Hasta ahora, el Congreso no ha adoptado el cambio.

segments.src: There's also a timing mismatch worth noting: the COLA is meant to help benefits keep pace with the cost of living, but it's calculated in the fall for the year ahead.
segments.tr: También hay un desajuste temporal que vale la pena señalar: el COLA está destinado a ayudar a que los beneficios sigan el ritmo del costo de vida, pero se calcula en otoño para el año siguiente.

segments.src: If inflation cools between now and January, retirees could end up ahead of rising costs.
segments.tr: Si la inflación se enfría entre ahora y enero, los jubilados podrían terminar por delante de los costos crecientes.

segments.src: If it accelerates instead, as it has in recent years, the raise can lag behind actual expenses almost as soon as it takes effect.
segments.tr: Si, por el contrario, se acelera, como ha ocurrido en años recientes, el aumento puede quedarse rezagado respecto a los gastos reales casi tan pronto como entra en vigor.

segments.src: ## Medicare Premiums Could Offset Part of the Gain
segments.tr: ## Las primas de Medicare podrían compensar parte de la ganancia

segments.src: For many retirees, the real-world impact of a COLA increase depends heavily on what happens to Medicare Part B premiums, which are usually deducted directly from Social Security checks.
segments.tr: Para muchos jubilados, el impacto en el mundo real de un aumento del COLA depende en gran medida de lo que suceda con las primas de la Parte B de Medicare, que generalmente se deducen directamente de los cheques del Seguro Social.

segments.src: Part B premiums have risen in most recent years, sometimes eating into a meaningful share of the annual raise before it ever reaches a beneficiary's bank account.
segments.tr: Las primas de la Parte B han aumentado en la mayoría de los años recientes, a veces consumiendo una parte significativa del aumento anual antes de que llegue a la cuenta bancaria del beneficiario.

segments.src: Medicare's premium figures for next year are typically announced around the same time as the COLA, and the two numbers are usually read together by financial planners who work with retirees.
segments.tr: Las cifras de las primas de Medicare para el próximo año generalmente se anuncian aproximadamente al mismo tiempo que el COLA, y los dos números suelen ser leídos juntos por los planificadores financieros que trabajan con jubilados.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Qué sucede después

segments.src: The Bureau of Labor Statistics will release September's inflation data in the coming weeks, which will finalize the COLA calculation.
segments.tr: La Oficina de Estadísticas Laborales publicará los datos de inflación de septiembre en las próximas semanas, lo que finalizará el cálculo del COLA.

segments.src: The Social Security Administration will then issue its official announcement, most likely in mid-October, setting the exact percentage that will apply to benefits starting in January.
segments.tr: La Administración del Seguro Social emitirá entonces su anuncio oficial, muy probablemente a mediados de octubre, estableciendo el porcentaje exacto que se aplicará a los beneficios a partir de enero.

segments.src: Until then, the 3.1% figure should be treated as an informed estimate based on partial data rather than a confirmed number.
segments.tr: Hasta entonces, la cifra del 3.1% debe tratarse como una estimación informada basada en datos parciales en lugar de un número confirmado.

segments.src: Beneficiaries who want to plan ahead can watch for the official announcement and use the Social Security Administration's own benefit statements and online tools to see how any adjustment will apply to their specific monthly payment.
segments.tr: Los beneficiarios que deseen planificar con anticipación pueden estar atentos al anuncio oficial y utilizar los estados de cuenta de beneficios y las herramientas en línea de la Administración del Seguro Social para ver cómo se aplicará cualquier ajuste a su pago mensual específico.

ar.title: 3.1% و69 مليون شيك: ماذا يعني التضخم المرتفع في أغسطس لزيادة الضمان الاجتماعي في العام المقبل

segments.src: A warmer-than-expected August inflation report has put a number on millions of kitchen-table budgets: an early projected Social Security cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) of roughly 3.1% for 2027.
segments.tr: أدى تقرير التضخم لشهر أغسطس، الذي جاء أعلى من المتوقع، إلى وضع رقم للميزانيات المنزلية لملايين الأسر: توقعات أولية لتعديل تكلفة المعيشة (COLA) للضمان الاجتماعي بنسبة 3.1% تقريبًا لعام 2027.

segments.src: If that estimate holds once the government finalizes the calculation this fall, it would mark one of the larger annual raises retirees have seen in several years — and a reminder of how closely the nation's largest income-support program is tied to the price of everyday goods.
segments.tr: إذا استمر هذا التقدير بمجرد إتمام الحكومة للحسابات هذا الخريف، فسيشكل واحدة من أكبر الزيادات السنوية التي شهدها المتقاعدون منذ عدة سنوات — وتذكيرًا بمدى ارتباط أكبر برنامج لدعم الدخل في البلاد بأسعار السلع اليومية.

segments.src: ## How the Raise Gets Calculated
segments.tr: ## كيف يتم حساب الزيادة

segments.src: Social Security's annual adjustment isn't set by lawmakers or the agency itself.
segments.tr: لا يتم تحديد التعديل السنوي للضمان الاجتماعي من قبل المشرعين أو الهيئة نفسها.

segments.src: It's derived from a formula written into law that compares average prices in the third quarter (July, August, and September) of the current year to the same period a year earlier, using a specific inflation gauge known as the CPI-W, which tracks spending by urban wage earners and clerical workers.
segments.tr: بل يُستمد من صيغة مدمجة في القانون تقارن متوسط الأسعار في الربع الثالث (يوليو وأغسطس وسبتمبر) من العام الحالي بنفس الفترة من العام السابق، باستخدام مؤشر تضخم محدد يُعرف باسم CPI-W، والذي يتتبع إنفاق أصحاب الأجور الحضرية والموظفين الكتابيين.

segments.src: Because the formula only uses three months of data, a single hot or cool reading can move the final number meaningfully.
segments.tr: نظرًا لأن الصيغة تستخدم بيانات ثلاثة أشهر فقط، فإن قراءة واحدة مرتفعة أو منخفضة يمكن أن تغير الرقم النهائي بشكل كبير.

segments.src: August's report came in above what many economists had penciled in, driven in part by shelter costs, food prices, and energy — categories that weigh heavily on fixed-income households.
segments.tr: جاء تقرير أغسطس أعلى مما تطلعه العديد من الاقتصاديين، مدفوعًا جزئيًا بتكاليف السكن وأسعار المواد الغذائية والطاقة — وهي الفئات التي تثقل كاهل الأسر ذات الدخل الثابت.

segments.src: With September's data still to come, the projected 3.1% figure is an estimate, not a final number.
segments.tr: مع استمرار انتظار بيانات سبتمبر، فإن الرقم المتوقع بنسبة 3.1% هو مجرد تقدير وليس رقمًا نهائيًا.

segments.src: The Social Security Administration typically announces the official COLA in mid-October, once the third-quarter data set is complete.
segments.tr: عادة ما تعلن إدارة الضمان الاجتماعي عن COLA الرسمي في منتصف أكتوبر، بمجرد اكتمال مجموعة بيانات الربع الثالث.

segments.src: ## What a 3.1% Raise Would Mean in Dollars
segments.tr: ## ماذا تعني زيادة بنسبة 3.1% بالأرقام المالية

segments.src: For context, recent COLAs have ranged widely — from historic highs during the inflation surge of the early 2020s to leaner increases in calmer years.
segments.tr: للسياق، تراوحت تعديلات COLA الأخيرة بشكل كبير — من مستويات قياسية خلال موجة التضخم في أوائل 2020 إلى زيادات أقل في السنوات الأكثر هدوءًا.

segments.src: A 3.1% bump applied to an average retirement benefit would translate into an increase of roughly $55 to $60 per month for a typical retired worker, though the exact figure varies by individual benefit amount.
segments.tr: إن تطبيق زيادة بنسبة 3.1% على متوسط إعانة التقاعد سينتج عنه زيادة تتراوح بين $55 و $60 شهريًا للعامل المتقاعد النموذجي، على الرغم من أن الرقم الدقيق يختلف بناءً على مبلغ الإعانة الفردي.

segments.src: Multiplied across the more than 69 million Americans who receive Social Security or Supplemental Security Income benefits, the aggregate impact on federal outlays is substantial, which is one reason the annual COLA announcement draws close attention from budget analysts as well as beneficiaries.
segments.tr: وبضرب هذا الرقم عبر أكثر من 69 مليون أمريكي يتلقون إعانات الضمان الاجتماعي أو دخل الضمان التكميلي، فإن الأثر الإجمالي على النفقات الفيدرالية يكون كبيرًا، وهو أحد الأسباب التي تجعل الإعلان السنوي عن COLA يجذب انتباهًا وثيقًا من محللي الميزانية وكذلك المستفيدين.

segments.src: ## Advocates Say the Formula Still Falls Short
segments.tr: ## المدافعون يقولون إن الصيغة لا تزال قاصرة

segments.src: Even with a larger-than-average adjustment on the horizon, groups that track senior finances caution that the COLA formula may not fully reflect how older Americans actually spend money.
segments.tr: حتى مع وجود تعديل أكبر من المتوسط في الأفق، تحذر المجموعات التي تتتبع الشؤون المالية لكبار السن من أن صيغة COLA قد لا تعكس بالكامل كيفية إنفاق كبار السن للأموال بالفعل.

segments.src: The CPI-W is built around a working-age household's spending patterns, not a retiree's.
segments.tr: يتم بناء CPI-W حول أنماط إنفاق الأسر في سن العمل، وليس المتقاعدين.

segments.src: Critics have long argued this understates the true cost pressure seniors face, since retirees typically devote a larger share of their budgets to housing and medical care — two categories that have outpaced general inflation in many recent years.
segments.tr: ولطالماجادل النقاد بأنه يقلل من تقدير ضغط التكلفة الحقيقي الذي يواجهه كبار السن، نظرًا لأن المتقاعدين يخصصون عادةً حصة أكبر من ميزانياتهم للسكن والرعاية الطبية — وهما فئتان تجاوزتا التضخم العام في العديد من السنوات الأخيرة.

segments.src: Some advocacy organizations have pushed for Social Security to instead use the CPI-E, an experimental index that more heavily weights spending by Americans age 62 and older, including healthcare and housing costs.
segments.tr: دفعت بعض منظمات والدفاع نحو استخدام الضمان الاجتماعي لمؤشر CPI-E بدلاً من ذلك، وهو مؤشر تجريبي يزن بشدة إنفاق الأمريكيين الذين تبلغ أعمارهم 62 عامًا فما فوق، بما في ذلك تكاليف الرعاية الصحية والسكن.

segments.src: Proponents argue this would produce more accurate — and often larger — annual adjustments.
segments.tr: يجادل المؤيدون بأن هذا سينتج تعديلات سنوية أكثر دقة — وغالبًا ما تكون أكبر.

segments.src: So far, Congress has not adopted the change.
segments.tr: حتى الآن، لم يعتمد الكونغرس هذا التغيير.

segments.src: There's also a timing mismatch worth noting: the COLA is meant to help benefits keep pace with the cost of living, but it's calculated in the fall for the year ahead.
segments.tr: هناك أيضًا عدم توافق في التوقيت يستحق الملاحظة: يُقصد من COLA مساعدة الإعانات على مواكبة تكلفة المعيشة، ولكن يتم حسابه في الخريف للعام المقبل.

segments.src: If inflation cools between now and January, retirees could end up ahead of rising costs.
segments.tr: إذا انخفض التضخم بين الآن ويناير، فقد ينتهي الأمر بالمتقاعدين متقدمين على التكاليف المتزايدة.

segments.src: If it accelerates instead, as it has in recent years, the raise can lag behind actual expenses almost as soon as it takes effect.
segments.tr: أما إذا تسارع بدلاً من ذلك، كما حدث في السنوات الأخيرة، فقد تتخلف الزيادة عن المصاريف الفعلية بمجرد دخولها دخل التنفيذ تقريبًا.

segments.src: ## Medicare Premiums Could Offset Part of the Gain
segments.tr: ## أقساط Medicare قد تقتطع جزءًا من الزيادة

segments.src: For many retirees, the real-world impact of a COLA increase depends heavily on what happens to Medicare Part B premiums, which are usually deducted directly from Social Security checks.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للعديد من المتقاعدين، يعتمد التأثير الواقعي لزيادة COLA بشكل كبير على ما يحدث لأقساط Medicare Part B، والتي يتم خصمها عادةً مباشرة من شيكات الضمان الاجتماعي.

segments.tr: عادة ما يتم الإعلان عن أرقام أقساط Medicare للعام المقبل في نفس الوقت تقريبًا مع COLA، ويتم قراءة الرقمين معًا عادةً من قبل المخططين الماليين الذين يعملون مع المتقاعدين.

segments.src: ## What a 3.1% Raise Would Mean in Dollars

segments.src: For context, recent COLAs have ranged widely — from historic highs during the inflation surge of the early 2020s to leaner increases in calmer years.
segments.tr: Pour comparaison, les récents COLA ont varié considérablement — des sommets historiques lors de la poussée inflationniste du début des années 2020 à des augmentations plus modestes les années plus calmes.

segments.src: A 3.1% bump applied to an average retirement benefit would translate into an increase of roughly $55 to $60 per month for a typical retired worker, though the exact figure varies by individual benefit amount.
segments.tr: Une hausse de 3,1 % appliquée à une prestation de retraite moyenne se traduirait par une augmentation d'environ 55 $ à 60 $ par mois pour un travailleur retraité type, bien que le chiffre exact varie selon le montant de la prestation individuelle.

segments.src: Multiplied across the more than 69 million Americans who receive Social Security or Supplemental Security Income benefits, the aggregate impact on federal outlays is substantial, which is one reason the annual COLA announcement draws close attention from budget analysts as well as beneficiaries.
segments.tr: Multiplié par les plus de 69 millions d'Américains qui perçoivent des prestations de la Sécurité sociale ou du revenu complémentaire de sécurité (SSI), l'impact global sur les dépenses fédérales est considérable, ce qui explique en partie pourquoi l'annonce annuelle du COLA attire l'attention des analystes budgétaires ainsi que des bénéficiaires.

segments.src: ## Advocates Say the Formula Still Falls Short
segments.tr: ## Les défenseurs estiment que la formule est encore insuffisante

segments.src: Even with a larger-than-average adjustment on the horizon, groups that track senior finances caution that the COLA formula may not fully reflect how older Americans actually spend money.
segments.tr: Même avec un ajustement supérieur à la moyenne à l'horizon, les groupes qui suivent les finances des personnes âgées préviennent que la formule du COLA ne reflète peut-être pas pleinement la manière dont les Américains plus âgés dépensent réellement leur argent.

segments.src: The CPI-W is built around a working-age household's spending patterns, not a retiree's.
segments.tr: Le CPI-W est conçu autour des habitudes de dépenses d'un ménage en âge de travailler, et non de celles d'un retraité.

segments.src: Critics have long argued this understates the true cost pressure seniors face, since retirees typically devote a larger share of their budgets to housing and medical care — two categories that have outpaced general inflation in many recent years.
segments.tr: Les critiques soutiennent depuis longtemps que cela sous-estime la véritable pression sur les coûts à laquelle font face les seniors, les retraités consacrant généralement une plus grande part de leur budget au logement et aux soins médicaux — deux catégories qui ont surpassé l'inflation générale au cours de nombreuses années récentes.

segments.src: Some advocacy organizations have pushed for Social Security to instead use the CPI-E, an experimental index that more heavily weights spending by Americans age 62 and older, including healthcare and housing costs.
segments.tr: Certaines organisations de défense ont fait pression pour que la Sécurité sociale utilise plutôt le CPI-E, un indice expérimental qui pèse plus lourdement sur les dépenses des Américains âgés de 62 ans et plus, incluant les frais de santé et de logement.

segments.src: Proponents argue this would produce more accurate — and often larger — annual adjustments.
segments.tr: Les partisans soutiennent que cela produirait des ajustements annuels plus précis — et souvent plus importants.

segments.src: So far, Congress has not adopted the change.
segments.tr: Jusqu'à présent, le Congrès n'a pas adopté ce changement.

segments.src: There's also a timing mismatch worth noting: the COLA is meant to help benefits keep pace with the cost of living, but it's calculated in the fall for the year ahead.
segments.tr: Il y a également un décalage temporel à souligner : le COLA est censé aider les prestations à suivre le rythme du coût de la vie, mais il est calculé à l'automne pour l'année à venir.

segments.src: If inflation cools between now and January, retirees could end up ahead of rising costs.
segments.tr: Si l'inflation se tasse entre maintenant et janvier, les retraités pourraient se retrouver en avance sur la hausse des coûts.

segments.src: If it accelerates instead, as it has in recent years, the raise can lag behind actual expenses almost as soon as it takes effect.
segments.tr: Si elle s'accélère à la place, comme cela a été le cas ces dernières années, la hausse peut prendre du retard par rapport aux dépenses réelles presque dès son entrée en vigueur.

segments.src: ## Medicare Premiums Could Offset Part of the Gain
segments.tr: ## Les primes de Medicare pourraient compenser une partie du gain

segments.src: For many retirees, the real-world impact of a COLA increase depends heavily on what happens to Medicare Part B premiums, which are usually deducted directly from Social Security checks.
segments.tr: Pour de nombreux retraités, l'impact réel d'une augmentation du COLA dépend fortement de ce qui arrive aux primes de la partie B de Medicare, qui sont généralement déduites directement des chèques de la Sécurité sociale.

segments.src: Part B premiums have risen in most recent years, sometimes eating into a meaningful share of the annual raise before it ever reaches a beneficiary's bank account.
segments.tr: Les primes de la partie B ont augmenté au cours de la plupart des dernières années, grignotant parfois une part significative de la hausse annuelle avant même qu'elle n'atteigne le compte bancaire du bénéficiaire.

segments.src: Medicare's premium figures for next year are typically announced around the same time as the COLA, and the two numbers are usually read together by financial planners who work with retirees.
segments.tr: Les chiffres des primes de Medicare pour l'année prochaine sont généralement annoncés en même temps que le COLA, et les deux chiffres sont habituellement lus ensemble par les planificateurs financiers qui travaillent avec des retraités.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Que va-t-il se passer ensuite

segments.src: The Bureau of Labor Statistics will release September's inflation data in the coming weeks, which will finalize the COLA calculation.
segments.tr: Le Bureau of Labor Statistics publiera les données sur l'inflation de septembre dans les semaines à venir, ce qui finalisera le calcul du COLA.

segments.src: The Social Security Administration will then issue its official announcement, most likely in mid-October, setting the exact percentage that will apply to benefits starting in January.
segments.tr: L'Administration de la sécurité sociale émettra ensuite son annonce officielle, très probablement à la mi-octobre, fixant le pourcentage exact qui s'appliquera aux prestations à compter de janvier.

segments.src: Until then, the 3.1% figure should be treated as an informed estimate based on partial data rather than a confirmed number.
segments.tr: D'ici là, le chiffre de 3,1 % doit être traité comme une estimation informée basée sur des données partielles plutôt que comme un chiffre confirmé.

segments.src: Beneficiaries who want to plan ahead can watch for the official announcement and use the Social Security Administration's own benefit statements and online tools to see how any adjustment will apply to their specific monthly payment.
segments.tr: Les bénéficiaires qui souhaitent planifier à l'avance peuvent surveiller l'annonce officielle et utiliser les propres déclarations de prestations et outils en ligne de l'Administration de la sécurité sociale pour voir comment tout ajustement s'appliquera à leur paiement mensuel spécifique.

pt.title: 3,1% e 69 milhões de cheques: o que a inflação alta de agosto significa para o aumento da Previdência Social no próximo ano

segments.src: A warmer-than-expected August inflation report has put a number on millions of kitchen-table budgets: an early projected Social Security cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) of roughly 3.1% for 2027.
segments.tr: Um relatório de inflação de agosto mais quente do que o esperado colocou um número nos orçamentos domésticos de milhões de pessoas: um ajuste projetado antecipado do custo de vida (COLA) da Previdência Social de aproximadamente 3,1% para 2027.

segments.src: If that estimate holds once the government finalizes the calculation this fall, it would mark one of the larger annual raises retirees have seen in several years — and a reminder of how closely the nation's largest income-support program is tied to the price of everyday goods.
segments.tr: Se essa estimativa se mantiver quando o governo finalizar o cálculo neste outono, marcaria um dos maiores aumentos anuais que os aposentados viram em vários anos — e um lembrete de quão estreitamente o maior programa de apoio à renda do país está ligado ao preço dos bens do dia a dia.

segments.src: ## How the Raise Gets Calculated
segments.tr: ## Como o aumento é calculado

segments.src: Social Security's annual adjustment isn't set by lawmakers or the agency itself.
segments.tr: O ajuste anual da Previdência Social não é definido pelos legisladores ou pela própria agência.

segments.src: It's derived from a formula written into law that compares average prices in the third quarter (July, August, and September) of the current year to the same period a year earlier, using a specific inflation gauge known as the CPI-W, which tracks spending by urban wage earners and clerical workers.
segments.tr: Ele é derivado de uma fórmula escrita em lei que compara os preços médios no terceiro trimestre (julho, agosto e setembro) do ano atual com o mesmo período do ano anterior, usando um indicador de inflação específico conhecido como CPI-W, que rastreia os gastos de assalariados urbanos e trabalhadores administrativos.

segments.src: Because the formula only uses three months of data, a single hot or cool reading can move the final number meaningfully.
segments.tr: Como a fórmula usa apenas três meses de dados, uma única leitura alta ou baixa pode mover o número final de forma significativa.

segments.src: August's report came in above what many economists had penciled in, driven in part by shelter costs, food prices, and energy — categories that weigh heavily on fixed-income households.
segments.tr: O relatório de agosto veio acima do que muitos economistas haviam previsto, impulsionado em parte pelos custos de moradia, preços de alimentos e energia — categorias que pesam muito sobre as famílias de renda fixa.

segments.src: With September's data still to come, the projected 3.1% figure is an estimate, not a final number.
segments.tr: Com os dados de setembro ainda por vir, o número projetado de 3,1% é uma estimativa, não um número final.

segments.src: The Social Security Administration typically announces the official COLA in mid-October, once the third-quarter data set is complete.
segments.tr: A Administração da Previdência Social normalmente anuncia o COLA oficial em meados de outubro, assim que o conjunto de dados do terceiro trimestre estiver completo.

segments.src: ## What a 3.1% Raise Would Mean in Dollars
segments.tr: ## O que um aumento de 3,1% significaria em dólares

segments.src: For context, recent COLAs have ranged widely — from historic highs during the inflation surge of the early 2020s to leaner increases in calmer years.
segments.tr: Para contexto, os COLAs recentes variaram amplamente — desde máximas históricas durante o aumento da inflação do início dos anos 2020 até aumentos menores em anos mais calmos.

segments.src: A 3.1% bump applied to an average retirement benefit would translate into an increase of roughly $55 to $60 per month for a typical retired worker, though the exact figure varies by individual benefit amount.
segments.tr: Um aumento de 3,1% aplicado a um benefício médio de aposentadoria se traduziria em um aumento de aproximadamente $55 a $60 por mês para um trabalhador aposentado típico, embora o número exato varie de acordo com o valor do benefício individual.

segments.src: Multiplied across the more than 69 million Americans who receive Social Security or Supplemental Security Income benefits, the aggregate impact on federal outlays is substantial, which is one reason the annual COLA announcement draws close attention from budget analysts as well as beneficiaries.
segments.tr: Multiplicado pelos mais de 69 milhões de americanos que recebem benefícios da Previdência Social ou da Renda de Segurança Suplementar, o impacto agregado nos gastos federais é substancial, o que é uma das razões pelas quais o anúncio anual do COLA atrai muita atenção de analistas orçamentários, bem como dos beneficiários.

segments.src: ## Advocates Say the Formula Still Falls Short
segments.tr: ## Defensores dizem que a fórmula ainda é insuficiente

segments.src: Even with a larger-than-average adjustment on the horizon, groups that track senior finances caution that the COLA formula may not fully reflect how older Americans actually spend money.
segments.tr: Mesmo com um ajuste maior que a média no horizonte, grupos que monitoram as finanças dos idosos alertam que a fórmula do COLA pode não refletir totalmente como os americanos mais velhos realmente gastam dinheiro.

segments.src: The CPI-W is built around a working-age household's spending patterns, not a retiree's.
segments.tr: O CPI-W é construído em torno dos padrões de gastos de uma família em idade ativa, não de um aposentado.

segments.src: Critics have long argued this understates the true cost pressure seniors face, since retirees typically devote a larger share of their budgets to housing and medical care — two categories that have outpaced general inflation in many recent years.
segments.tr: Os críticos argumentam há muito tempo que isso subestima a verdadeira pressão de custo que os idosos enfrentam, já que os aposentados normalmente dedicam uma parcela maior de seus orçamentos a moradia e cuidados médicos — duas categorias que superaram a inflação geral em muitos anos recentes.

segments.src: Some advocacy organizations have pushed for Social Security to instead use the CPI-E, an experimental index that more heavily weights spending by Americans age 62 and older, including healthcare and housing costs.
segments.tr: Algumas organizações de defesa pressionaram para que a Previdência Social usasse o CPI-E, um índice experimental que pondera mais fortemente os gastos de americanos com 62 anos ou mais, incluindo custos de saúde e moradia.

segments.src: Proponents argue this would produce more accurate — and often larger — annual adjustments.
segments.tr: Os proponentes argumentam que isso produziria ajustes anuais mais precisos — e muitas vezes maiores.

segments.src: So far, Congress has not adopted the change.
segments.tr: Até agora, o Congresso não adotou a mudança.

segments.src: There's also a timing mismatch worth noting: the COLA is meant to help benefits keep pace with the cost of living, but it's calculated in the fall for the year ahead.
segments.tr: Há também uma incompatibilidade de tempo que vale a pena notar: o COLA destina-se a ajudar os benefícios a acompanhar o custo de vida, mas é calculado no outono para o ano seguinte.

segments.src: If inflation cools between now and January, retirees could end up ahead of rising costs.
segments.tr: Se a inflação esfriar entre agora e janeiro, os aposentados podem acabar à frente dos custos crescentes.

segments.src: If it accelerates instead, as it has in recent years, the raise can lag behind actual expenses almost as soon as it takes effect.
segments.tr: Se ela acelerar, como aconteceu nos últimos anos, o aumento pode ficar atrás das despesas reais quase assim que entrar em vigor.

segments.src: ## Medicare Premiums Could Offset Part of the Gain
segments.tr: ## Os prêmios do Medicare podem compensar parte do ganho

segments.src: For many retirees, the real-world impact of a COLA increase depends heavily on what happens to Medicare Part B premiums, which are usually deducted directly from Social Security checks.
segments.tr: Para muitos aposentados, o impacto no mundo real de um aumento do COLA depende muito do que acontece com os prêmios da Parte B do Medicare, que geralmente são deduzidos diretamente dos cheques da Previdência Social.

segments.src: Part B premiums have risen in most recent years, sometimes eating into a meaningful share of the annual raise before it ever reaches a beneficiary's bank account.
segments.tr: Os prêmios da Parte B aumentaram na maioria dos anos recentes, às vezes consumindo uma parte significativa do aumento anual antes mesmo de chegar à conta bancária do beneficiário.

segments.src: Medicare's premium figures for next year are typically announced around the same time as the COLA, and the two numbers are usually read together by financial planners who work with retirees.
segments.tr: Os números dos prêmios do Medicare para o próximo ano são normalmente anunciados na mesma época que o COLA, e os dois números são geralmente lidos juntos por planejadores financeiros que trabalham com aposentados.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## O que acontece a seguir

segments.src: The Bureau of Labor Statistics will release September's inflation data in the coming weeks, which will finalize the COLA calculation.
segments.tr: O Bureau of Labor Statistics divulgará os dados de inflação de setembro nas próximas semanas, o que finalizará o cálculo do COLA.

segments.src: The Social Security Administration will then issue its official announcement, most likely in mid-October, setting the exact percentage that will apply to benefits starting in January.
segments.tr: A Administração da Previdência Social emitirá então seu anúncio oficial, muito provavelmente em meados de outubro, definindo a porcentagem exata que se aplicará aos benefícios a partir de janeiro.

segments.src: Until then, the 3.1% figure should be treated as an informed estimate based on partial data rather than a confirmed number.
segments.tr: Até lá, o número de 3,1% deve ser tratado como uma estimativa informada baseada em dados parciais, em vez de um número confirmado.

segments.src: Beneficiaries who want to plan ahead can watch for the official announcement and use the Social Security Administration's own benefit statements and online tools to see how any adjustment will apply to their specific monthly payment.
segments.tr: Os beneficiários que desejam planejar com antecedência podem ficar atentos ao anúncio oficial e usar as declarações de benefícios e ferramentas online da própria Administração da Previdência Social para ver como qualquer ajuste se aplicará ao seu pagamento mensal específico.

in.title: 3,1% dan 69 Juta Cek: Apa Arti Inflasi Agustus yang Tinggi bagi Kenaikan Jaminan Sosial Tahun Depan

segments.src: A warmer-than-expected August inflation report has put a number on millions of kitchen-table budgets: an early projected Social Security cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) of roughly 3.1% for 2027.
segments.tr: Laporan inflasi bulan Agustus yang lebih panas dari perkiraan telah memberikan angka yang jelas pada jutaan anggaran rumah tangga: penyesuaian biaya hidup (COLA) Jaminan Sosial yang diproyeksikan awal sekitar 3,1% untuk tahun 2027.

segments.src: If that estimate holds once the government finalizes the calculation this fall, it would mark one of the larger annual raises retirees have seen in several years — and a reminder of how closely the nation's largest income-support program is tied to the price of everyday goods.
segments.tr: Jika perkiraan tersebut bertahan setelah pemerintah menyelesaikan penghitungan pada musim gugur ini, hal ini akan menandai salah satu kenaikan tahunan terbesar yang pernah dilihat para pensiunan dalam beberapa tahun terakhir — dan menjadi pengingat betapa eratnya program dukungan pendapatan terbesar di negara ini terikat dengan harga barang sehari-hari.

segments.src: ## How the Raise Gets Calculated
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana Kenaikan Dihitung

segments.src: Social Security's annual adjustment isn't set by lawmakers or the agency itself.
segments.tr: Penyesuaian tahunan Jaminan Sosial tidak ditetapkan oleh pembuat undang-undang atau badan itu sendiri.

segments.src: It's derived from a formula written into law that compares average prices in the third quarter (July, August, and September) of the current year to the same period a year earlier, using a specific inflation gauge known as the CPI-W, which tracks spending by urban wage earners and clerical workers.
segments.tr: Hal ini berasal dari rumus yang tertulis dalam undang-undang yang membandingkan harga rata-rata pada kuartal ketiga (Juli, Agustus, dan September) tahun berjalan dengan periode yang sama tahun sebelumnya, menggunakan pengukur inflasi khusus yang dikenal sebagai CPI-W, yang melacak pengeluaran oleh pekerja upahan perkotaan dan pekerja administrasi.

segments.src: Because the formula only uses three months of data, a single hot or cool reading can move the final number meaningfully.
segments.tr: Karena rumus tersebut hanya menggunakan data tiga bulan, pembacaan yang tinggi atau rendah dapat mengubah angka akhir secara signifikan.

segments.src: August's report came in above what many economists had penciled in, driven in part by shelter costs, food prices, and energy — categories that weigh heavily on fixed-income households.
segments.tr: Laporan bulan Agustus berada di atas perkiraan banyak ekonom, didorong sebagian oleh biaya tempat tinggal, harga makanan, dan energi — kategori yang sangat membebani rumah tangga berpenghasilan tetap.

segments.src: With September's data still to come, the projected 3.1% figure is an estimate, not a final number.
segments.tr: Dengan data bulan September yang masih akan datang, angka proyeksi 3,1% adalah perkiraan, bukan angka akhir.

segments.src: The Social Security Administration typically announces the official COLA in mid-October, once the third-quarter data set is complete.
segments.tr: Administrasi Jaminan Sosial biasanya mengumumkan COLA resmi pada pertengahan Oktober, setelah kumpulan data kuartal ketiga selesai.

segments.src: ## What a 3.1% Raise Would Mean in Dollars
segments.tr: ## Apa Arti Kenaikan 3,1% dalam Bentuk Uang

segments.src: For context, recent COLAs have ranged widely — from historic highs during the inflation surge of the early 2020s to leaner increases in calmer years.
segments.tr: Sebagai konteks, COLA baru-baru ini bervariasi secara luas — dari rekor tertinggi historis selama lonjakan inflasi pada awal tahun 2020-an hingga peningkatan yang lebih kecil pada tahun-tahun yang lebih tenang.

segments.src: A 3.1% bump applied to an average retirement benefit would translate into an increase of roughly $55 to $60 per month for a typical retired worker, though the exact figure varies by individual benefit amount.
segments.tr: Kenaikan 3,1% yang diterapkan pada tunjangan pensiun rata-rata akan diterjemahkan menjadi peningkatan sekitar $55 hingga $60 per bulan untuk pekerja pensiunan tipikal, meskipun angka persisnya bervariasi menurut jumlah tunjangan individu.

segments.src: Multiplied across the more than 69 million Americans who receive Social Security or Supplemental Security Income benefits, the aggregate impact on federal outlays is substantial, which is one reason the annual COLA announcement draws close attention from budget analysts as well as beneficiaries.
segments.tr: Jika dikalikan dengan lebih dari 69 juta warga Amerika yang menerima tunjangan Jaminan Sosial atau Pendapatan Keamanan Tambahan, dampak agregat pada pengeluaran federal sangat besar, yang merupakan salah satu alasan mengapa pengumuman COLA tahunan menarik perhatian dekat dari analis anggaran serta penerima manfaat.

segments.src: ## Advocates Say the Formula Still Falls Short
segments.tr: ## Para Advokat Mengatakan Rumus Tersebut Masih Kurang

segments.src: Even with a larger-than-average adjustment on the horizon, groups that track senior finances caution that the COLA formula may not fully reflect how older Americans actually spend money.
segments.tr: Bahkan dengan penyesuaian yang lebih besar dari rata-rata di depan mata, kelompok yang memantau keuangan lansia mengingatkan bahwa rumus COLA mungkin tidak sepenuhnya mencerminkan bagaimana orang Amerika yang lebih tua benar-benar membelanjakan uang.

segments.src: The CPI-W is built around a working-age household's spending patterns, not a retiree's.
segments.tr: CPI-W dibangun di sekitar pola pengeluaran rumah tangga usia kerja, bukan pensiunan.

segments.src: Critics have long argued this understates the true cost pressure seniors face, since retirees typically devote a larger share of their budgets to housing and medical care — two categories that have outpaced general inflation in many recent years.
segments.tr: Para kritikus telah lama berpendapat bahwa ini meremehkan tekanan biaya sebenarnya yang dihadapi para lansia, karena para pensiunan biasanya mencurahkan sebagian besar anggaran mereka untuk perumahan dan perawatan medis — dua kategori yang telah melampaui inflasi umum dalam banyak tahun terakhir.

segments.src: Some advocacy organizations have pushed for Social Security to instead use the CPI-E, an experimental index that more heavily weights spending by Americans age 62 and older, including healthcare and housing costs.
segments.tr: Beberapa organisasi advokasi telah mendorong agar Jaminan Sosial sebagai gantinya menggunakan CPI-E, indeks eksperimental yang lebih memberatkan pengeluaran oleh orang Amerika berusia 62 tahun ke atas, termasuk biaya perawatan kesehatan dan perumahan.

segments.src: Proponents argue this would produce more accurate — and often larger — annual adjustments.
segments.tr: Para pendukung berpendapat ini akan menghasilkan penyesuaian tahunan yang lebih akurat — dan seringkali lebih besar.

segments.src: So far, Congress has not adopted the change.
segments.tr: Sejauh ini, Kongres belum mengadopsi perubahan tersebut.

segments.src: There's also a timing mismatch worth noting: the COLA is meant to help benefits keep pace with the cost of living, but it's calculated in the fall for the year ahead.
segments.tr: Ada juga ketidakcocokan waktu yang patut dicatat: COLA dimaksudkan untuk membantu tunjangan mengikuti biaya hidup, tetapi dihitung pada musim gugur untuk tahun depan.

segments.src: If inflation cools between now and January, retirees could end up ahead of rising costs.
segments.tr: Jika inflasi mendingin antara sekarang dan Januari, para pensiunan bisa berakhir di depan biaya yang meningkat.

segments.src: If it accelerates instead, as it has in recent years, the raise can lag behind actual expenses almost as soon as it takes effect.
segments.tr: Jika sebaliknya berakselerasi, seperti yang terjadi dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, kenaikan tersebut dapat tertinggal di belakang pengeluaran aktual hampir begitu mulai berlaku.

segments.src: ## Medicare Premiums Could Offset Part of the Gain
segments.tr: ## Premi Medicare Dapat Mengimbangi Sebagian Keuntungan

segments.src: For many retirees, the real-world impact of a COLA increase depends heavily on what happens to Medicare Part B premiums, which are usually deducted directly from Social Security checks.
segments.tr: Bagi banyak pensiunan, dampak dunia nyata dari kenaikan COLA sangat bergantung pada apa yang terjadi pada premi Medicare Bagian B, yang biasanya dipotong langsung dari cek Jaminan Sosial.

segments.src: Part B premiums have risen in most recent years, sometimes eating into a meaningful share of the annual raise before it ever reaches a beneficiary's bank account.

ja.title: 3.1%と6900万通の小切手：8月のインフレ加速が意味する来年の社会保障増額への影響

segments.src: A warmer-than-expected August inflation report has put a number on millions of kitchen-table budgets: an early projected Social Security cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) of roughly 3.1% for 2027.
segments.tr: 予想を上回る8月のインフレ報告により、何百万もの家庭の家計簿に具体的な数字が突きつけられました。2027年の社会保障費の生計費調整（COLA）の初期予測は、およそ3.1%となっています。

segments.src: If that estimate holds once the government finalizes the calculation this fall, it would mark one of the larger annual raises retirees have seen in several years — and a reminder of how closely the nation's largest income-support program is tied to the price of everyday goods.
segments.tr: この秋に政府が計算を確定した際にもこの予測値が維持されれば、退職者がここ数年で目にした中では最大規模の年間増額の一つとなり、全米最大の所得保障プログラムがいかに日用品の価格と密接に結びついているかを改めて思い知らされることになるでしょう。

segments.src: ## How the Raise Gets Calculated
segments.tr: ## 増額はどのように計算されるのか

segments.src: Social Security's annual adjustment isn't set by lawmakers or the agency itself.
segments.tr: 社会保障の年次調整は、国会議員や社会保障局自体によって設定されるわけではありません。

segments.src: It's derived from a formula written into law that compares average prices in the third quarter (July, August, and September) of the current year to the same period a year earlier, using a specific inflation gauge known as the CPI-W, which tracks spending by urban wage earners and clerical workers.
segments.tr: これは法律に組み込まれた計算式から導き出されます。この計算式は、都市部の賃金労働者や事務職の支出を追跡するCPI-Wと呼ばれる特定のインフレ指標を用いて、当年の第3四半期（7月、8月、9月）の平均価格を前年の同時期と比較するものです。

segments.src: Because the formula only uses three months of data, a single hot or cool reading can move the final number meaningfully.
segments.tr: この計算式は3ヶ月分のデータしか使用しないため、1回でもインフレ率が高かったり低かったりするだけで、最終的な数値が大きく変動する可能性があります。

segments.src: August's report came in above what many economists had penciled in, driven in part by shelter costs, food prices, and energy — categories that weigh heavily on fixed-income households.
segments.tr: 8月の報告は、多くのエコノミストが想定していた数値を上回りました。これは、固定収入で暮らす世帯に重くのしかかる住居費、食料品価格、エネルギーなどのカテゴリーが主な要因となっています。

segments.src: With September's data still to come, the projected 3.1% figure is an estimate, not a final number.
segments.tr: 9月のデータがまだ控えているため、予測されている3.1%という数字はあくまで見積もりであり、確定値ではありません。

segments.src: The Social Security Administration typically announces the official COLA in mid-October, once the third-quarter data set is complete.
segments.tr: 社会保障局は通常、第3四半期のデータがすべて揃った10月中旬に公式のCOLAを発表します。

segments.src: ## What a 3.1% Raise Would Mean in Dollars
segments.tr: ## 3.1%の増額が意味する具体的な金額

segments.src: For context, recent COLAs have ranged widely — from historic highs during the inflation surge of the early 2020s to leaner increases in calmer years.
segments.tr: 参考までに、近年のCOLAは、2020年代初頭のインフレ急進時の歴史的な高水準から、より落ち着いた年の小幅な引き上げまで、幅広く推移してきました。

segments.src: A 3.1% bump applied to an average retirement benefit would translate into an increase of roughly $55 to $60 per month for a typical retired worker, though the exact figure varies by individual benefit amount.
segments.tr: 平均的な退職年金に3.1%の引き上げが適用された場合、一般的な退職労働者にとって月額およそ$55から$60の増額に相当しますが、正確な金額は個人の受給額によって異なります。

segments.src: Multiplied across the more than 69 million Americans who receive Social Security or Supplemental Security Income benefits, the aggregate impact on federal outlays is substantial, which is one reason the annual COLA announcement draws close attention from budget analysts as well as beneficiaries.
segments.tr: 社会保障や補足的保障所得（SSI）を受給している6900万人以上のアメリカ人全体にこれを掛け合わせると、連邦政府の歳出に対する累積的な影響は多大なものとなります。これが、年次のCOLA発表が受給者だけでなく予算アナリストからも高い注目を集める理由の一つです。

segments.src: ## Advocates Say the Formula Still Falls Short
segments.tr: ## 擁護団体は「計算式は依然として不十分」と主張

segments.src: Even with a larger-than-average adjustment on the horizon, groups that track senior finances caution that the COLA formula may not fully reflect how older Americans actually spend money.
segments.tr: 平均を上回る調整が見込まれているものの、高齢者の家計を追跡している団体は、COLAの計算式が高齢者の実際の支出状況を十分に反映していない可能性があると警告しています。

segments.src: The CPI-W is built around a working-age household's spending patterns, not a retiree's.
segments.tr: CPI-Wは、退職者ではなく、働く世代の世帯の支出パターンに基づいて構築されています。

segments.src: Critics have long argued this understates the true cost pressure seniors face, since retirees typically devote a larger share of their budgets to housing and medical care — two categories that have outpaced general inflation in many recent years.
segments.tr: 批判的な人々は、退職者が通常、予算の大部分を住居費や医療費（近年、一般的なインフレ率を上回るペースで上昇している2つのカテゴリー）に充てているため、高齢者が直面している真のコスト圧力が過小評価されていると長年主張してきました。

segments.src: Some advocacy organizations have pushed for Social Security to instead use the CPI-E, an experimental index that more heavily weights spending by Americans age 62 and older, including healthcare and housing costs.
segments.tr: 一部の擁護団体は、社会保障において代わりにCPI-Eを使用するよう求めています。これは、医療費や住居費を含め、62歳以上のアメリカ人の支出をより重視した試験的な指数です。

segments.src: Proponents argue this would produce more accurate — and often larger — annual adjustments.
segments.tr: 支持者らは、これにより、より正確で、多くの場合より大きな年次調整が行われるようになると主張しています。

segments.src: So far, Congress has not adopted the change.
segments.tr: これまでのところ、議会はこの変更を採用していません。

segments.src: There's also a timing mismatch worth noting: the COLA is meant to help benefits keep pace with the cost of living, but it's calculated in the fall for the year ahead.
segments.tr: また、注目すべきタイミングのズレもあります。COLAは給付金が生計費のペースに遅れないようにすることを目的としていますが、計算されるのは前年の秋です。

segments.src: If inflation cools between now and January, retirees could end up ahead of rising costs.
segments.tr: 現在から1月までの間にインフレが沈静化すれば、退職者は上昇するコストを上回る恩恵を受けられる可能性があります。

segments.src: If it accelerates instead, as it has in recent years, the raise can lag behind actual expenses almost as soon as it takes effect.
segments.tr: 逆に、近年見られたようにインフレが加速した場合、増額分が適用された直後から実際の支出に追いつかなくなる可能性があります。

segments.src: ## Medicare Premiums Could Offset Part of the Gain
segments.tr: ## メディケア保険料が増額分の一部を相殺する可能性

segments.src: For many retirees, the real-world impact of a COLA increase depends heavily on what happens to Medicare Part B premiums, which are usually deducted directly from Social Security checks.
segments.tr: 多くの退職者にとって、COLA増額の現実的な影響は、通常は社会保障の小切手から直接差し引かれるメディケア・パートBの保険料に何が起こるかに大きく左右されます。

segments.src: Part B premiums have risen in most recent years, sometimes eating into a meaningful share of the annual raise before it ever reaches a beneficiary's bank account.
segments.tr: パートBの保険料はここ数年、ほとんどの年で上昇しており、年次増額分のかなりの割合が受給者の銀行口座に届く前に相殺されてしまうこともあります。

segments.src: Medicare's premium figures for next year are typically announced around the same time as the COLA, and the two numbers are usually read together by financial planners who work with retirees.
segments.tr: 来年のメディケア保険料の数値は通常、COLAとほぼ同時期に発表され、退職者をサポートするファイナンシャルプランナーは通常、この2つの数値を合わせて読み解きます。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 今後の展開

segments.src: The Bureau of Labor Statistics will release September's inflation data in the coming weeks, which will finalize the COLA calculation.
segments.tr: 労働統計局は数週間以内に9月のインフレデータを発表し、これによりCOLAの計算が確定します。

segments.src: The Social Security Administration will then issue its official announcement, most likely in mid-October, setting the exact percentage that will apply to benefits starting in January.
segments.tr: その後、社会保障局は、おそらく10月中旬に公式発表を行い、1月から適用される正確な給付引き上げ率を設定します。

segments.src: Until then, the 3.1% figure should be treated as an informed estimate based on partial data rather than a confirmed number.
segments.tr: それまでは、3.1%という数字は確定した数値ではなく、部分的なデータに基づく情報提供を目的とした予測値として扱う必要があります。

segments.src: Beneficiaries who want to plan ahead can watch for the official announcement and use the Social Security Administration's own benefit statements and online tools to see how any adjustment will apply to their specific monthly payment.
segments.tr: 事前に計画を立てたい受給者は、公式発表を待ち、社会保障局独自の給付明細書やオンラインツールを使用して、調整が個々の月々の支払いにどのように適用されるかを確認することができます。

segments.src: It's derived from a formula written into law that compares average prices in the third quarter (July, August, and September) of the current year to the same period a year earlier, using a specific inflation gauge known as the CPI-W, which tracks spending by urban wage earners and clerical workers.
segments.tr: Sie leitet sich aus einer gesetzlich verankerten Formel ab, die die Durchschnittspreise im dritten Quartal (Juli, August und September) des laufenden Jahres mit dem gleichen Zeitraum des Vorjahres vergleicht, unter Verwendung eines spezifischen Inflationsmaßstabs, bekannt als CPI-W, der die Ausgaben von städtischen Lohn- und Gehaltsempfängern erfasst.

segments.tr: ## Was eine Erhöhung um 3.1% in Dollar bedeuten würde

segments.tr: ## Befürworter sagen, die Formel greife immer noch zu kurz

segments.src: The CPI-W is built around a working-age household's spending patterns, not a retiree's.
